title: Example documentation review

metric.label: Documentation for independent review
metric.question: How well is this sample record documented for independent review?

method.description: Sum each criterion weight multiplied by its reviewer-assigned rating. Ratings are 0 (insufficient), 0.5 (partial), or 1 (adequate for this review). A missing rating withholds the whole score. No weights are redistributed.

applicability: Applies to the named material observation and the exact seven-file review scope retained in this fictional example.

missingData.description: Withhold the whole score when any required criterion judgment is missing. Do not substitute zero or redistribute its weight.

limitations: The providers, judgments and source material are fictional. No physical collection or laboratory work occurred.
The score describes this selected documentation review; it does not establish source authenticity, laboratory validity or anomalous behavior.
The method uses authored reviewer judgments. Recomputing the arithmetic does not independently justify those judgments.
Only the seven retained files form this scoring input scope. Other files referenced by the wider record have not been reviewed here.
